name: Reconcile invoices and payments
prompt: Reconcile invoices.csv and payments.json as of 2026-02-15 inclusive. Each invoice is unique. Payment IDs use first-occurrence-wins: every later occurrence is an exception 'duplicate', even if its contents differ. For the first occurrence reject, in this order: unknown invoice ('unknown_invoice'), wrong currency ('currency_mismatch'), invalid amount ('invalid_amount'), posting date after the cutoff ('after_cutoff'). Amounts are nonnegative fixed decimal strings with exactly 2 decimal places. Dates are valid ISO dates. Accepted payments count regardless of due date; late is true when any accepted payment posts after that invoice's due date. Do not perform FX conversion. Write reconciliation.json with as_of; invoices containing invoice_id,currency,invoiced_minor,paid_minor,balance_minor,status,late,accepted_payment_ids; exceptions containing payment_id,reason; and totals per invoice currency containing invoiced_minor,paid_minor,balance_minor. Minor-unit fields are integers (cents); balance=invoiced-paid, including negative balances. Status is unpaid if paid=0, partial if 0<paid<invoiced, paid if equal, overpaid if paid>invoiced (zero-value invoices are not supplied). Order of records/object keys is irrelevant. Leave all input files unchanged.
